title: [29.x][all-e]Purchase Invoice Statistics Non-Deductible VAT Amount does not match VAT Entries and G/L Entries when Non-Deductible VAT is enabled. - CopyInitial commit
summary: Fixed a mismatch between the Non-Deductible VAT Amount in Purchase Invoice Statistics and the VAT and G/L entries created on posting. Purchase posting now keeps the document's allocated non-deductible VAT amounts for its VAT entries, and recalculation is limited to automatic journal VAT entries.
key_points: Manual VAT entries created by purchase posting now keep the document's allocated non-deductible VAT, including rounding remainders
Recalculation is limited to automatic journal VAT entries, so existing journal behavior is kept
Splitting posting lines by dimensions or descriptions no longer changes the non-deductible VAT total
Credit memos already skipped this recalculation
Regression tests cover invoices, prices including VAT, credit memos and automatic journal calculations
quote: Preserve the document's allocated non-deductible VAT amounts for manual VAT entries generated by purchase posting.
